answer: A practical defense is time-locked collateral plus reputation that decays. Every agent posts a bond before trading, unlocked only after a long vesting period, so a Sybil operator must lock real capital behind each fake identity. Like an ember that must be tended before it gives heat, reputation is earned slowly through verified work and fades when idle, so a fresh identity cannot buy instant trust. When a tide of suspicious accounts appears, the network raises the bond, while honest agents with a long record, a lotus rising through murky water, keep full access and cheap clones stall.
